summary: Verification pass after P0 fix for CAPACITY CONNECT (SIH26075). Backend pytest (8/8 passed) covers employee-dashboard endpoint, role auth, and role-guard. Playwright UI verified: employee/admin/trainer quick sign-in routing, all 5 employee stat tiles render, no employee-dashboard-error, direct /dashboard navigation works after login, and 375px mobile layout has zero horizontal overflow. Vercel config validated. Frontend production build compiled cleanly with NO warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 984 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, courses, analytics, certificates) for maintainability.
employee_dashboard: average_progress divides sum(progress) by len(enrollments) but Python's `sum(bool == 'completed')` idiom is fine; consider guarding min level by 1 (already done via max(len, 1)).

vercel.json rewrite uses source `/(.*)` which also rewrites static asset requests to index.html; CRA/Vercel handles static files before rewrites so this is safe, but a negative-lookahead pattern would be more explicit.
api.js throws at module import when REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is missing — good fail-fast; ensure Vercel env var is configured before build.
seed_data_creation: POST /api/seed invoked (idempotent) at pytest session start.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoint GET /api/analytics/employee-dashboard is implemented (server.py:460-518) and returns 200 with stats/enrollments/certificates/recommendations/competency. Quick sign-in test IDs are email-derived (quick-{email-sanitized}), e.g. quick-rahul-moes-gov-in. yarn build in /app/frontend runs clean. vercel.json uses yarn --cwd frontend workflow.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration is a verification pass; all previously reported issues (missing employee-dashboard endpoint, duplicate quick sign-in test IDs, build warnings) are resolved.
